description: Source code, frozen execution snapshots, original and additional project-level aggregate evidence, actual-fit receipts and figure source data for the TRACE evaluation framework. Three full CodeBERT fits, a frozen-encoder reference and three hashing fits share PrimeVul source roles. Additional DiverseVul and MegaVul cohorts are reported separately. The artifact supports aggregate reconstruction without redistributing raw datasets, model weights, row-level predictions or label vaults. It does not include manuscript prose, author declarations or mock reviews.
